# dna order

Orders.

## dna order get

```
dna order get <order-code> [flags]
```

Show an order and its lines.

- **Safety:** read-only (no side effects)
- **API:** `GET /api/v1/order/{orderCode}`
- **Returns:** `OrderDto`
- **Schema:** `dna schema order.get` (MCP tool: `order_get`)

Every input can also be given as JSON with --body (inline, @file or - for stdin); flags override it.

| flag | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `--order-code` | string | Order code (required; or argument 1 &lt;order-code&gt;) |
| `-d`, `--body` | string | Full input as JSON: inline, @file, or - to read stdin |
